name: Meito Co., Ltd.
summary: Meito Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of confectionery, beverages, seasoned foods, food additives, and other food products in Japan and internationally. It provides chocolates, such as alphabet, nut, best assortment, strawberry, adult-oriented liquor, crunchy dome, creamy, cookie crunch, peanut, donut, and acorn picnic chocolates; and premix such as lemon, apple, peach, royal milk, stickmate rooibos and jasmine, warm ginger, and melting fruit tea; lemonade, masala chai, stickmate assortment, aquamate, milk cocoa, and jelly. The company also offers candies, which includes soda mix, fruit drops, butter salt, crushed slated lemon, mineral salt candy; vitamin C, herb mint ice cream…
